## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. Product: Replicate model API. API model: wan-video/wan-2.1-1.3b. Settings: resolution=480p (only option), frame\_num=81 (default; 16 fps playback). Price basis: published per-output-video rate ÷ the 5-second duration Replicate states; shorter frame\_num settings cost the same per video. Currency: USD. Not an Alibaba direct tariff. ### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp16 + umt5 q4_k_m (sd.cpp), needs ~8.6 GB, from [github.com/leejet](https://github.com/leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp/blob/3f8527a46c54ecf4cb4ed6003da8e8982283c73c/docs/wan.md))
   
   ```sh
   sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0
   ```

Other versions: fp16 + umt5 q8_0 (sd.cpp) (~11.5 GB) `sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q8_0.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0`
